review.summary: The docs-site chunk meets the acceptance threshold. Source and deployment bindings verify offline, acceptance enforces the binding, and retained evidence supports the 0.2.5 documentation update. No blocker or high finding remains; one historical footer needs clarification.

findings.description: The evidence footer still describes current native execution as Linux musl and links to historical phase status and the 0.1.0 registry receipt. Both phase-31 attempt-02 receipts identify x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu, making this footer inconsistent with the current qualification described above.
findings.required_fix: Identify GNU as the phase-31 execution target and link the current release evidence. Label retained musl and 0.1.0 references explicitly as historical.

evidence: Read AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, docs/PHASES.md, docs/implementation-plan.md, the accepted phases 29–31 plan, and phase 31's status entry.
Recomputed source fingerprint: 0c6408af8120ffd046fe12554f5a31ebcc0572b058651321527b161718106c9b. check_evidence accepted the complete 113-command passing report.

Inspected site changes, configuration, pinned deployment workflow, and per-commit push/deployment receipts. All five retained local HTML pages and three protected images match the deployment receipt hashes.
Verified the updated qualification links resolve to files in the local v0.2.5 Git tag; inspected both attempt-02 live receipts and their GNU target identities.

Executed offline release_delivery.verify successfully: published source 4adbe971bce30b129bbd9a1a858540f4bca6c22b, CI successor bcbab09acb983838068cf987f8cf4ad93e423b3f, 49 successful contexts. Both schema-3 compiler package proofs and retained archives verified.
limitations: No network requests, tenant access, credential reads, or checkout modifications were performed.
Builds, compiler tests, and mutation-based regression tests were not rerun; their preserved results were inspected. Offline source, binding, delivery, and artifact-hash verification were executed.
Deployment and service outcomes rely on retained observations; current remote availability and browser rendering were not independently checked.
This score covers the docs-site chunk, not complete-phase acceptance.
